title: Jaclyn B
content: At about 11 PM on July 28, 2025, I was driving and was in an auto accident. I was T-boned by a drunk driver. My car rolled over multiple times and landed upside down in a lake or canal. I was instantly submerged in water. I didn’t realize I was upside down until the next day when I saw videos. Physically, it shouldn't have been possible. But, I had a small pocket of air in the upper left corner of the car. Moving even slightly made this pocket of air shrink. The water covered my ears, and everything became eerily quiet as I tried to stay calm and find a way out. The water kept rising, and my air pocket continued to grow smaller. I started choking when I tried to breathe. When I realized I couldn’t escape or hold my breath any longer, I said my goodbyes. Just before losing consciousness, I felt my arm being pulled. The next thing I remember is being in a hospital room after traveling through a long, black tunnel into outer space, deep in the galaxy. I arrived at what looked like a pink planet which seemed like an alternate reality. A higher power was with me in physical form, although it appeared as a black silhouette. It guided me around the place. I saw people who I knew had passed away on earth. The silhouette showed me an area with benches where people sat with their heads down, looking depressed. When I asked about them, it explained they were people who had committed suicide and regretted it. Those people who didn’t regret it, lived peacefully among the others, as if in another version of Earth. Everyone was walking around. I felt overwhelming peace and love like never before. Occasionally, I heard my name being screamed and felt people pressing down on me. It was as if my body was fighting between life and death. I just wanted to sleep. I was clinically dead for six minutes before my loved ones and the silhouette told me it wasn’t my time. So, I had to go back to my body. I’ve always been psychic but never embraced it. Since then, multiple souls have been reaching out to me in real life, and I’m unsure how to handle it. Some of these souls I had known and others were unknown to me. Twice, strangers stopped me on the street, saying my deceased best friend had a message for me. Both knew extremely specific details about his death such as his name, car color, and location. These are things they couldn’t have known otherwise. Now, there are many times when I’m lying in bed and feel someone standing over me or lying beside me. I sense powerful energies around me. Some energies are negative and some are positive. It’s as if this experience opened some sort of portal. This experience happened only e weeks ago, so I guess this is the start of a new journey in life.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, My third eye was pounding, and I was very aware and more sensitive to everything.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I felt like I was able to gain insight on what happens after you die.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I could hear more voices of souls after my experience.

elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, First, I went through a black tunnel very fast. Once it ended, I was speeding through outer space.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, In the black tunnel, there was a light at the end.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, It was like an alternate reality. People were walking around as they normally would on Earth.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Buddhist, I believe in a higher power.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, It was a silhouette of a being with a very calming energy.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, Being a messenger of what souls are trying to tell their families after death
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I had conversations with deceased loved ones. They were all at peace.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, The silhouette explained we were in a realm where souls go when they die. There was another realm between Earth and where I was, for souls who couldn't accept their death and needed someone in the higher plane to call them up. I was told I could only be contacted by souls struggling to accept their death. I am a messenger, and many deceased loved ones contacted me with messages for their families. When I delivered the messages, the souls were no longer in the middle realm; they were taken up.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: As explained, going to that planet or realm, and seeing what I saw, I’m being told what I was told, opened up some sort of portal for souls to contact me
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I still remember it in very much detail, exactly what I’m explaining
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, Souls constantly try to contact me
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, Gained good knowledge and insight about life after death
